data.name: Lubena
data.gender_notes: Lubena is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'lub' which means 'to flow'. This name signifies the grace, elegance, and beauty of a gentle flowing river. It is also associated with the fragrant and graceful flower, the lily. The name Lubena carries the meaning “Graceful, elegant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Lubena usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, elegant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the spiritual grace and beauty of a soul that is in harmony with the divine.
data.etymology: Lubena belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, elegant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lubena total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: لُبِنَة
in_arabic.meaning: هي اسم فاعل من أسماء الذكر ومعناه الصالح و البرى
in_arabic.long_meaning: يسعد اسم لُبِنَة في اللغة العربية ومعناه الصالح و البرى، وهو اسم فاعل من أسماء الذكر، ويراد به في القرآن الكريم الصالحون الذين يتبعون سنتهم، ويُعتبر لُبِنَة من أسماء الإلهية، حيث يُعتبر من أسماء الله تعالى التي يُستخدمها لتسمية الصالحين، ويمكن ترجمة لُبِنَة إلى الوديعة، وهي من أسماء الله تعالى التي يُستخدمها لوصف الصالحين، ويراد بها في اللغة العربية الصالحون الذين يتبعون سنتهم.
